_note: Table 1 for Discord: the slash commands the bot registers (tools/discord/register.ts) and the one-line help each shows in /help and on table-1.site/discord. Keep this file the source: the web copy at table-1-events-web/src/lib/discordCommands.json must be identical (discord.test.ts).

help.text: What the bot can do, in one message only you see.
Link your Discord account to your Table 1 account (a one-time link, 10 minutes). Signed in to Table 1 with Discord? You're already linked.
Remove the link between this Discord account and your Table 1 account.
Make a Table 1 event and post its card here: format, name, when and where, player cap, top 8, rounds (automatic when left out), set or cube. You're seated as the organizer.
Post the card of an event you run or play in: pick it from your events, or paste its link.
The open events posted in this server.
An event's card again, with Sign up and Drop, only you can see.
Sign up for an event (the same as the Sign up button). Full event? You join the waitlist.
Leave an event before round 1, or leave its waitlist. The next person in line moves up.
Post the final standings with a link to the event on Table 1. Organizers can post standings so far during the event.
Post one of your decks: name, format, card counts, Spice and a link anyone can open. The bot asks before it makes that link.
Post your wants, or one card you want: what you're after, which printing, the price now, and a link anyone can open. The bot asks before it makes that link.
Post your cards for trade, or one of them: printing, finish, condition and price, with a link anyone can open. The bot asks before it makes that link.
Look up a card: cost, type, cheapest TCGplayer price, image.
The time zone this server's event times are read in (people with Manage Server). Posted times show in each viewer's own zone.
